wholePhysicalScope: Public Aeronautics Museum grounds at the former Maracay airfield in September 2021, including the public entrance gate, pavilion and the mapped museum gallery and hangar buildings.
lodDetails: All four levels preserve the gallery, hangars, entrance pavilion and gate. Near views add open steel trusses, grille, entrance lettering and roof seams.
limitations: The open museum grounds and main building outlines follow the named map controls. Only the structures inside the public museum site are represented.
The gate and principal entrance elevation are derived from period photographs. Their exact ground footprints, roof junctions, finished grades and other elevations are estimates.
The former airfield’s public buildings are presented as they appeared in the September 2021 evidence. Aircraft, vehicles and sculpture are outside the scope.
